Thus we need to identify possible exception scenarios: (1) entry.hashCode throws RuntimeException. (2) exit.hashCode throws RuntimeException. (3) Both non-null and cause exception. Also maybe Objects.hash may throw IllegalArgumentException if array is null? Not applicable.

Thus we design test cases that trigger exception by using a Trade implementation that throws in hashCode.
